findings.title: Seasonal acquisition is materially incomplete
findings.proof: Carthage has 281 raw candidates, none seasonally classified. Aurora Maize, Pickin' Patch and Exeter have in-radius current-season evidence but never reach ingestion. Exeter OSM node 12298081054 is tourism=theme_park, absent from the actual query; the unchanged normalizer and OFF predicate accept it if supplied.
findings.recommendation: Add bounded complementary seasonal queries and maintained activity/event sources with current-year provenance. Cover theme-park/attraction/farm/trail representations with precision controls. Benchmark multiple regional origins; do not patch only seven local venues.

findings.title: Generic mazes are incorrectly classified as corn mazes
findings.proof: Actual Aurora OSM node 3388827330, Turtle Moon Labyrinth, has attraction=maze and is classified corn-maze. Operator historical material describes a meditation labyrinth; no corn qualification was found. A hedge-maze fixture reproduces the same rule.
findings.recommendation: Require positive corn/agricultural activity evidence; distinguish generic, hedge and meditation mazes. Add actual-node and generic-maze negatives alongside valid corn-maze positives.

findings.title: Visible eligibility does not integrate strict availability and lifecycle policy
findings.proof: Actual UI predicate lets unknown-hours live venues pass Open Now; Aurora retains Turtle Moon ON. Werehouse is retained OFF after its confirmed window in the Nov 1 fixture although isSeasonalDateSelectable is false. Structured disused tags are not handled. Strict helper tests pass because the actual UI does not call those helpers.
findings.recommendation: Define separate open, closed, unknown-hours, upcoming, finished-season and permanent-closure states, then apply one approved policy in actual UI eligibility. Keep appropriate OFF browsing; require positive current hours/date evidence for the documented strict ON policy; refresh status as time passes.

findings.title: First uniqueness map loses multi-activity evidence
findings.proof: Same name and rounded coordinates in C then P records leave P-only through actual transport; reversing order leaves C-only. Direct dedupe can union types, but occurs after last-write loss. Not observed as a missing-primary-live-venue cause.
findings.recommendation: Merge types/provenance before discarding identity duplicates. Require order-independent category preservation and unique option IDs; separately validate nearby distinct-venue merge rules.

findings.title: Unconfirmed status is rendered Closed and Myer schedule evidence is stale
findings.proof: Actual OptionsOverlay renders Closed for Myer despite Schedule unconfirmed decoration. Fresh direct operator calendar has October 2026 active dates, contradicting the frozen Sept 7 note. Numeric count remains correct.
findings.recommendation: Display schedule uncertainty distinctly; reverify and refresh current calendar in separately authorized data work. Retain provenance, checked dates and expiry/revalidation rules.

findings.title: Saved-only seasonal coverage is not disclosed on successful sparse queries
findings.proof: Valid empty live response plus local anchors returns source=merged without warning after one request. Carthage live seasonal pool consists only of two anchors. Actual outage path correctly uses fallback and warning. Count is exact, but does not describe source completeness.
findings.recommendation: Disclose selected-category source contribution/freshness and saved-only limitations separately from provider health. Preserve honest eligible counts and distinguish sparse success from outages.

severityRationale: No demonstrated blocker in current primary reproduction: known-closed filtering, union, radius, count, pick/options and incomplete-plan guard function for captured data. Unknown/lifecycle and metadata defects merit remediation; no actual currently known-closed venue shown passing ON, real permanently closed venue asserted shown, or material radius/count corruption established. Not release approval.
